mapper.sql: id, customer_id, contract_id, order_no, items_json, total, status, paid_at, shipped_at, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE opc_crm_order SET customer_id = #{customerId}, contract_id = #{contractId}, items_json = #{itemsJson}, total = #{total}, status = #{status}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, shipped_at = #{shippedAt}, remark = #{remark}, deleted = #{deleted}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.contract_id, o.order_no, o.items_json, o.total, o.status, o.paid_at, o.shipped_at, o.remark, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.deleted FROM opc_crm_order o JOIN opc_crm_customer cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND cu.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND cu.deleted = 0

SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.contract_id, o.order_no, o.items_json, o.total, o.status, o.paid_at, o.shipped_at, o.remark, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.deleted FROM opc_crm_order o JOIN opc_crm_customer cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} AND cu.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND cu.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.contract_id, o.order_no, o.items_json, o.total, o.status, o.paid_at, o.shipped_at, o.remark, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.deleted FROM opc_crm_order o JOIN opc_crm_contract ct ON ct.id = o.contract_id JOIN opc_crm_customer cu ON cu.id = ct.customer_id WHERE o.contract_id = #{contractId} AND cu.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND ct.deleted = 0 AND cu.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opc_crm_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
